scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older teacher in a rust-colored mantle leans forward with an open hand and his other hand over his chest. scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering gives visible form to the apostolic exhortation: the teacher's earnest appeal and the listeners' attentive posture suggest a response to grace rather than receiving it in vain.
